issue_context.title: Check if /etc/sysconfig/network exists before trying to edit
issue_context.body:
At https://github.com/hashicorp/vagrant/blob/master/plugins/guests/redhat/cap/change_host_name.rb#L14-L21 `sed` tries to edit `/etc/sysconfig/network` and related files, but if these doesn't exist in the box Vagrant fails.

```
==> fedora: Setting hostname...
The following SSH command responded with a non-zero exit status.
Vagrant assumes that this means the command failed!

# Update sysconfig
sed -i 's/\(HOSTNAME=\).*/\1fedora/' /etc/sysconfig/network
# Update DNS
sed -i 's/\(DHCP_HOSTNAME=\).*/\1"fedora"/' /etc/sysconfig/network-scripts/ifcfg-*

Stdout from the command:

Stderr from the command:

sed: can't read /etc/sysconfig/network-scripts/ifcfg-*: No such file or directory
```

`vagrant ssh fedora` works after a while:

```
[vagrant@localhost ~]$ sudo grep -Ri hostname /etc/sysconfig/
[vagrant@localhost ~]$ ls /etc/sysconfig/
anaconda  authconfig  chronyd  console  firewalld  kernel  man-db  modules  network  network-scripts  nftables.conf  rpcbind  selinux  sshd
[vagrant@localhost ~]$ ls /etc/sysconfig/network-scripts/
[vagrant@localhost ~]$ cat /etc/redhat-release 
Fedora release 32 (Thirty Two)
[vagrant@localhost ~]$ sudo hostnamectl set-hostname fedora
[vagrant@localhost ~]$ hostname
fedora
[vagrant@localhost ~]$
```

### Vagrant version

Vagrant 2.2.10

### Guest operating system

`bento/fedora-32`

### Vagrantfile

```ruby
  config.vm.define "fedora" do |fedora|
    fedora.vm.box = "bento/fedora-32"
    fedora.ssh.insert_key = true
    fedora.vm.network "private_network", ip: "10.2.3.44"
    fedora.vm.provider "virtualbox" do |f|
      f.default_nic_type = "virtio"
    end
    fedora.vm.hostname = "fedora"
    fedora.vm.provision "shell",
      inline: "dnf install -y ansible"
    fedora.vm.provision "ansible" do |a|
      a.verbose = "v"
      a.limit = "all"
      a.playbook = "tests/test.yml"
      a.extra_vars = {
        "sshd_admin_net" => "0.0.0.0/0",
        "sshd_allow_groups" => "vagrant sudo",
        "ansible_python_interpreter" => "/usr/bin/python3"
      }
    end
  end
```

### Expected behavior

Fedora 32 box up and running, with successful provision using Ansible.

### Actual behavior

Hostname configuration failed, and Vagrant configuration exited.
